findings.title: Some cases still depend on wall-clock timing
findings.detail: The gate-budget tests (test_gate_budget_runs_from_the_slot_hold, test_gate_budget_falls_back_to_the_workers_own) rely on sleep durations measured against small budgets, with about 3.8 s of slack. test_concurrent_jobs_see_their_own_base polls a sync dir from a shell loop inside a 60 s gate timeout. test_held_slot_gives_slot_wait_then_started asserts waited_s >= 0.5. These have margins and use tests/waits.py `until` where they can, but they could still flake on a very loaded CI host.

findings.ac: `nw worker info --json` prints the documented keys
findings.title: info test does not check git/uv/version values
findings.detail: test_info_json_keys checks the exact key set, schema, protocol, data_dir and that free_bytes is an int. It does not check that `version` matches nightwright.__version__ or that `git` is non-null on a host that has git. A regression that always returned None for these values would still pass.
